rationale: ORE-2015 ontology ore_ont_10009.owl (CMO clinical-measurement ontology, EL approximation). ORE-2015 ontologies are known-consistent benchmark inputs (they are the working-set reasoners are scored on); HermiT and Konclude both report them consistent. Verdict kept conservative — consistency only — because hand-authoring the exact ORE classification is not tractable; the harness at least guards the load + axiom count + consistency surface.
